main_text.l: עָשָׁק m. עֲשָׁקָה f. Oppressio, Fraus.
עשר idem: item Decimas dare. Hiphil
עָשָׂר Chal. Idem: תְּרֵי עָשָׂר Duodecim, Dan. 4.
עָשׂוֹר m. Idem: item Decachordum, instrumentum musicum.
עֲשֶׂרֶת עֲשָׂרָה m. Chal. עַשְׂרָה Decem: plur.
עֲשָׂרָה Decem: semper alii numerali nomini postponitur: ut אַחַת עֶשְׂרֵה undecim.
עַשִּׂירִי m. Decimus fæmin. עֲשִׂירִית Decima, Pars decima.

page.notes: The Hebrew vowel points and some Hebrew words are uncertain at this scan resolution and may contain small errors. The "(26." at the right of the line beginning "עֶשֶׂר" is a printed reference, kept in place. The running head is the Hebrew letter shin.
